hardware: two NVIDIA RTX A4000 GPUs without NVLink

implementation_screen.method: Host-staged FGMRES with separately compiled Schur and preconditioner actions
implementation_screen.operator_contract: Replicate each Krylov vector onto the explicit two-GPU operator mesh and return exact replicated results to the right-hand side device for Arnoldi work.
implementation_screen.component_decomposition: Three momentum components padded to four, with two independently converging solves per GPU.

two_gpu_diagnostics.initial_failure_removed: The inherited explicit replicated sharding made the small Arnoldi update stall beyond 180 seconds; separating Krylov-state and operator shardings removed that stall.
two_gpu_diagnostics.end_to_end_gate: The first two-step production solve did not complete within 180 seconds and did not reach the first-solve checkpoint.
two_gpu_diagnostics.physics_parity: not evaluated because the bounded two-GPU solve did not complete

replicated_krylov_state_screen.solvax_gates: 17 focused Krylov tests passed; full suite 233 passed in 246.58 seconds; strict warning-as-error documentation build passed.
replicated_krylov_state_screen.portable_contract: An explicit two-CPU-device replicated Krylov solve converged in 14 iterations with residual 1.1128912365939964e-10 and retained two addressable shards.
replicated_krylov_state_screen.method: Keep Krylov and Arnoldi state replicated on the operator mesh with explicit compiled Arnoldi input/output shardings, eliminating per-action replicate/gather transitions.
replicated_krylov_state_screen.gpu_failure: The first two-step production solve again exceeded 180 seconds. The explicit mesh pulled modal-factor vmap compilation and later electric setup compilation into multi-device programs, so the first-solve checkpoint was never reached.
replicated_krylov_state_screen.source_after_screen: All LMX wiring was removed; the reusable state_sharding API remains on the pushed SOLVAX branch.

decision.result: rejected and fully removed from LMX
decision.reason: A public two-GPU path must beat the 69.52-second one-GPU reference. Per-action sharding transitions erase the isolated 1.70x Schur speedup and the complete path exceeds 180 seconds.
decision.retained_solvax_work: The general host-staged GMRES and explicit operator/state sharding boundary are retained on the pushed SOLVAX branch; all 233 tests and strict docs pass.
decision.lmx_source_after_screen: No public B1 two-GPU solve, temporary trace hook, diagnostic environment switch, or unreleased SOLVAX dependency remains.

next_gate: Stop B1 component decomposition. Design a balanced spatial/domain decomposition that keeps modal-factor and electric setup outside the runtime mesh, then require exact one/two-GPU physics and a first-solve time below 69.52 seconds before public wiring.
